notes: No SEC filings; all figures come from the Tencent Annual Report 2024 as published on HKEXnews (filed 8 April 2025), which reports in RMB (ISO CNY). Ownership is as at 31 December 2024 from the SFO Part XV registers in the Directors' Report, not a proxy record date. Ma Huateng's 8.72% is held through Advance Data Services Limited (wholly owned by him), partly via Ma Huateng Global Foundation; the report lists it as a corporate interest, not a personal one. Buybacks are the cash-flow line 'Payments for repurchase of shares' (RMB 102,331m). This excludes RMB 3,420m of 'Payments for shares purchased/withheld for share award schemes', which buys shares for employee awards rather than returning cash. The Chairman's Statement gives about HKD 112 billion of repurchases and an HKD 3.40 dividend (about HKD 32 billion); those HKD figures are not used. Dividends exclude RMB 2,385m paid to non-controlling interests. Stock comp is the employee benefits expense line (RMB 23,424m); the non-IFRS reconciliation shows a smaller 'equity-settled share-based compensation' of RMB 20,702m for 2024 (Adjusted EBITDA table), which is a different, narrower measure. Tencent's www.tencent.com investor pages returned HTTP 567 to automated requests (re-checked 2026-11-23), so HKEXnews was used. All figures were re-checked on 2026-11-23 against a fresh download of the HKEXnews PDF.
